rules: The maximum counts the whole release: world cover, portraits, districts, places and homes together.
Only listed assets may intentionally show the railway bridge. Additional incidental appearances require visual review and still count against the maximum of 10.
Never append the world-cover panorama to district, place, home or portrait prompts.
Frame each location around its own authored architecture, activity, landscape and furnishings.
Private home images focus inward on their distinct rooms. Window views use courtyards, neighboring walls, vegetation or sky.
An allowed bridge view must show the bridge unfinished, with a visible incomplete span.
Count actual visible bridges during image review; prompt compliance alone is not proof.
